About

I’m a Software Tester and Full-Stack Web Developer, and a graduate of the Faculty of Computers and Artificial Intelligence at Helwan University.

I have hands-on experience in software testing and test automation through academic and graduation projects. I enjoy testing applications, finding bugs, and making sure software works as expected.

I have experience working on and building full-stack web applications, including Frontend and Backend development, databases, APIs, and deployment. I have worked with technologies such as Python, Django, JavaScript, .NET, and C++.

I also have a good understanding of Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning concepts. I’m currently preparing for the ISTQB CTFL certification and continuously working on improving my technical and problem-solving skills.

More recently, I've also worked on data pipelines, BI dashboards, and virtualization labs through academic projects — applying the same testing and full-stack mindset to data engineering and infrastructure work.

Data Science / ML

Credit Risk Classification

A comparative machine learning project predicting loan default risk (high vs. low) on a public credit-risk dataset, covering the full pipeline from preprocessing to a deployed prediction app.

Key details

  • Dataset: Kaggle Credit Risk Dataset — 32,581 records, 11 features
  • Compared Perceptron, Logistic Regression, SVM, Random Forest, and a tuned neural network
  • Best result: Random Forest at 93.46% test accuracy; optimized neural network at 92.17%
  • Added dropout regularization and early stopping to reduce overfitting
  • Deployed as an interactive Streamlit app for real-time risk prediction

Technologies

PythonScikit-learnKeras / TensorFlow PandasStreamlitJupyter Notebook
View Notebook
Team ProjectData Analytics / BI

Insurance Claims Decision Support System

An end-to-end ETL and business intelligence system for insurance claims data, built for a Decision Support Systems course as part of a 6-person team.

Key features

  • SSIS pipeline in SQL Server Data Tools merging raw CSV, TXT, and Excel claim sources into one staging table
  • Resolved code-page and string-length mismatches to unify mixed-format source data
  • Power BI dashboard covering claim status, payment methods, regional exposure, yearly trends, and agent performance
  • Custom DAX measures and Power Query columns for claims and premium analysis

Technologies

SQL ServerSSISSSDT Power BIPower QueryDAX
GitHub
Data Engineering

Agriculture Data Warehouse Pipeline

A production-style data warehouse pipeline for agricultural yield data, combining automated ingestion, transformation, and orchestration into a Power BI-ready analytics layer.

Key features

  • Apache NiFi ingestion moving incoming CSV files into a SQL Server raw layer
  • dbt transformations building a staging layer and a star schema in a mart layer
  • Dockerized Apache Airflow orchestrating the ingestion-to-transformation pipeline end to end
  • Power BI dashboard connected to the mart schema for reporting

Technologies

Apache NiFiSQL Serverdbt Apache AirflowDockerPower BI

Infrastructure / Virtualization

VMware vSphere ICM Project

A virtualization and infrastructure management project on VMware vSphere: a two-host ESXi cluster managed centrally through vCenter, running and testing a small API service across hosts.

Key features

  • Two ESXi hosts managed centrally through VMware vCenter Server Appliance (VCSA)
  • Two Ubuntu VMs across the hosts — one running a Node.js API, one used as a test client
  • Cross-host connectivity and API testing between the VMs
  • Live migration (vMotion) of a running VM between hosts
  • Snapshot, clone, and OVF-based backup workflows
